name: Revtech Manufacturing
old_description: RevTech Manufacturing was built on a strong foundation of innovation, experience, and precision. The brand grew from two companies founded by Leonard Koren: GK Engineering, a 3D printing company started in 1997, and International Mold and Production LLC, launched in 2003. This history reflects a long-standing commitment to advanced manufacturing and dependable production solutions.
about:
RevTech Manufacturing is based in Kenosha, Wisconsin. The business traces its roots to 1997 when Leonard Koren founded GK Engineering, a 3D printing company, and to 2003 when he launched International Mold and Production LLC. Those two entities were later combined under the RevTech Manufacturing brand, which today operates with Leonard Koren as president and family members holding key management roles.

The company provides a full spectrum of manufacturing services, including CAD design, in‑house CMM inspection, mold design, CNC and EDM mold fabrication, additive manufacturing (3D printing), plastic injection molding, stainless steel polishing, prototype and production tooling, and custom handle and grip solutions. RevTech also maintains an offshore mold‑building operation, IMAP, with capabilities in Asia and Europe, allowing it to support projects from early prototyping through long‑term production.

RevTech serves businesses across a broad geographic footprint — including the Chicago, Milwaukee, Atlanta, Dallas, and Scottsdale areas — that require custom plastic parts, tooling, and additive manufacturing. Typical customers are companies needing design assistance, prototype development, or full‑scale injection molded components for applications ranging from consumer products to industrial equipment.

The company emphasizes its decades of experience in both 3D printing and injection molding as a core differentiator. It promotes a full‑service model that spans design, validation, tooling, and production, backed by in‑house quality checks and a commitment to on‑time delivery. RevTech states its mission is to deliver high‑quality, defect‑free parts on schedule while providing expert guidance at every stage.
